svg.title: Topograph Slinky Engine Flow
svg.desc: Slinky engine flow showing Kubernetes watch triggers, node-data-broker annotations, provider discovery, Slurm pod-to-node mapping, and ConfigMap topology output for Slurm on Kubernetes.
svg.text: Network fabric via ibnetdiscover or NetQ
waits for API and broker readiness
maps K8s Nodes to Slurm nodes
maps Ready slurmd Pods to Kubernetes Nodes
Solid: requests, topology data, node metadata, and ConfigMap updates
Dashed: Kubernetes watches, readiness checks, and trigger calls
